description:
How did Satan survive if sin cannot exist the God's presence? Daniel Perrin, along with John Lomacang, and Shelley Quinn will answer this question and many more in this edition of 3ABN Today Bible Q & A hosted by Angela Lomacang.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.     I understand that Ham committed sexual immorality by having sex with his father while his father was drunk. But I have encountered other Christians who believe that Ham's sin was just to see the nakedness of his father (no sexual intercourse). Please help us to clarify the matter. What was Ham's sin? 

2.     What's the role of the Holy Spirit? 

3.     I was baptized at the age of 12 but left the church when I was 16. I feel God is calling me back to the church but I struggle with fornication. Can you explain Hebrews 10:26? The Holy Spirit led me to scriptures about fornication but my flesh still yearns for it even though I know it's wrong. Are there sins that God won't forgive once we have knowledge of them and still do them? 

4.     How can I stop sinning? 

5.     If sin can't exist in the presence of God the Father, how did Satan survive when he was going about Heaven lying and sinning against God? How does he survive at the Savior's return when all other unrepentant sinners don't? If sin can't exist in the presence of God, how did Satan survive? 

6.  What is the biblical dynamic between a man and a woman? And between a husband and wife? 

7.  Why was Aaron not punished by God when he created the golden calf while Moses was upon the mountain with God? Why was Aaron not punished for creating the golden calf? 

8.  Can someone set aside a day for worship instead of the normal Sabbath, and embrace that day as the official rest day in accordance with them? Can any day be set aside as the Sabbath? 

9.  I am taking care of my uncle and don’t go to church but follow on 3ABN. I do not pay tithe in any church. Is giving to the needy considered a form of tithing? 

10.  Can you explain the Intertestamental period? 

11.  My Seventh-day Adventist church moved, and is now too far away so I do not have a church to attend. My only other options are Lutheran or Catholic churches. I do not have internet access. I do have 3ABN on my TV. What can I do? Can I watch the service on 3ABN TV on Sabbath? Does that count in God's eyes? The Lutheran church doesn't have Saturday worship but the Catholic church does offer Saturday service. What can I do if my church is to far away?

12.  If God is real, why does he allow suffering?
